_comment: Difficulty presets (Phase 13). Per CLAUDE.md's product requirements and docs/kaiser-research.md's phased-build note: presets vary how CAPABLE and how ADVANTAGED the rivals are, never the underlying rules. Every rank threshold, event formula, upkeep curve, and mitigation coefficient stays identical across presets — only two things move: (1) rivalEvaluationSeeds, how many independent futures each rival's planner averages a candidate plan over before picking one (src/ai/planner.ts's EVALUATION_SEEDS, per-rival override) — fewer seeds means a rival's own plan is judged on noisier information and it plays less robustly, not that it breaks a rule; (2) rivalStartingMultiplier, a head-start or handicap applied ONLY to rivals' starting taler and farmland (src/engine/starter.ts) — the human always starts at the same baseline the research doc specifies (15,000 Taler, 10,000 ha).

presets.name: Easy
presets.description: Rivals plan against a single guess at the future and start from a modest handicap. Forgiving for a first reign.

presets.name: Standard
presets.description: Rivals plan and start exactly as the balance harness measures them. The baseline every ai-bench/balance number in this repo is reported against.

presets.name: Hard
presets.description: Rivals weigh more futures before committing to a plan and start with a real head start. Nothing about the rules changes — they are simply better-prepared and better-off.
